newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar dips in range on month-end selling.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar dips in range on month-end selling.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar ended slightly lower on Wednesday on month-end corporate selling after trading a narrow range.
By 5 p.m. (0500 GMT) the currency was at US$0.6928/35 from its 0.6942/49 open, having traded a 0.6930-48 range on the day.
"The Kiwi is just a little lower with a little bit of month-end corporate selling, which has put a bit of a dampener on it for the time being," said one Auckland dealer.
"But over the next 24 hours or so we are still going to be in a 0.6925-55 range," he said.
"There is still underlying buying interest from offshore with various dual currency bond issues overnight.
"I would imagine they would still be about over the next two or three days," he said.
